title: Fizz Water Burn
description: Fizz Water Burn — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 7 samples of Fizz Water and return to Agent Fess in Townston. Start with the Blademasters and Broodlings.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Distilling the Truth

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 7 samples of Fizz Water and return to Agent Fess in Townston. Start with the Blademasters and Broodlings.

Offer:

It looks like the Whiskers here found some fresh veins of Fizz Rock. That's the cause of all the excitement. Worse, they are using the Fizz Rock to make some kind of drink! I'm not really sure on just how they can drink a rock. I guess they refine it or something.

I've seen some Whiskers down here drinking the stuff, I've been calling it Fizz Water. From the looks of it, Fizz Water is an energy drink. And from the smell of it, well, it probably tastes how it smells. If it really is an energy drink, this could make Fizz Rock some kind of multi-purpose power source. Someone should probably look into this some more. You don't look like you're especially busy....

I've been offered this Fizz Water from Whiskers throughout Algernon. Your best bet is to concentrate on them to get samples. I would help, but I can't break my cover.

When you have a couple samples, bring them back to Agent Fess up in Townston.

Turn-in:

So this is the so-called Fizz Water Agent Hammer was talking about? Good Gosh! It smells like...well, I'm sure you already know.

The label calls it FizzStar. It looks like the Whiskers decided to violate the Kingdom's Disallowance Act and try to compete with Townston's own brand of energy drink! Those dirty rats! We can't have them competing with us. It's enough having to deal with all of the energy drinks coming from Vergrim's Brood. More on that in, oh, about 20 levels.

By the way, what more can you tell me about these strange locked doors you saw? And I've been getting some reports of some especially large two-legged Whiskers down there. Did you notice anything strange?

Objectives:

  • Samples of Fizz Water ×7

Client level range: 3–20
